about.certainty_rule: green = established (known science, or a defined / proved result in Maths); orange = leading idea / partial progress; red = unknown / open problem. A link takes the colour of its less-certain end.

about.what_this_is: Index of the Echo Atlas AI data files. Load only the section you need.

files.about: Universe → Us map and ring: from "Before the Big Bang?" to us, including Chain Theory (one candidate starting point, orange) and its open gap (red).
A dated timeline of the universe from the Big Bang to today: the first second, the first nuclei and light, cosmic dawn, galaxies and the Sun, Earth and life. The time scale changes between eras.

Forces, particles and light: the four fundamental interactions, the Standard Model, antimatter, dark matter, light, relativity and quantum electrodynamics, with the open questions (quantum gravity, unification, neutrino mass, baryon asymmetry).
Maths map and ring: definitions, proved theorems, partial progress and open problems across 16 branches.
A dated timeline (one or more landmarks for every Maths node), across five eras. Proposed ideas are kept apart from proofs.
Earth from space to the inner core: atmosphere layers, ocean, crust, mantle and core, with real depths in km.
A typical human cell: organelles, molecules, atoms and living processes, drawn to scale where possible.
Organs, bones, muscles, vessels and nerves, and which kinds of cell build each part.

All 118 elements with symbols, groups and simplified cosmic origins (where each element was mostly made). The Atom Sandbox uses this table; it is a teaching toy with preset reactions, not a quantum simulator.
